sources.use: The behaviour specification this package implements. Nothing upstream was opened, decompiled or read to write this package.

The rights record the specification was written under, which clears code and behaviour and leaves names unresolved. Two consequences are visible in this package: no identifier here is carried across, so aliases.json is empty; and the four compatibility-required spellings that record names -- the channel and payload suffixes, the pack descriptor key, the highlight directory and its parting key, and the eleven validator kind names -- are each read from a build-time input, are an error rather than a default when the build supplies nothing, and have a placeholder the tests pin the surrounding shape with.

The whole of what this package names of Ravel's own surface: content declaration and the registration barrier, the packet contract and its framing, saved-data declaration and versioning, the side model and its client-only isolation, and the open JSON value the three open surfaces carry.
